name: Deathmaster Snikch
canonNotes: Chief Assassin of Clan Eshin, whose location is always unknown and whose mark is a sign traced in blood.
Serves Lord Sneek with deadly efficiency.
voiceNotes: Barely present, whispered and chilling; few words.
Implies threats rather than stating them.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
